verdict.rationale: Circle documents a custodial-style offering (Circle Mint) for 'qualified businesses' to hold/convert USD-USDC balances, backed 100% by cash-equivalents and redeemable 1:1 (circle-docs-13, circle-docs-27), but the docs never spell out specific geographies, eligibility gating, or account minimums. More importantly, hands-on community evidence directly contradicts the 'always redeemable 1:1' claim: during the SVB crisis Circle admitted $3.3B of reserves were stuck at a failing bank, USDC depegged to $0.85, and critics questioned Circle's treasury diversification and transparency about redemption risk. Missing for 10: explicit geography/eligibility disclosure for Circle Mint, and an honest first-party acknowledgment of reserve-concentration risk that the community evidence shows was understated.
